significance: A Shiva temple in the Padi neighbourhood of Chennai, revered in the 7th-century Tevaram and counted among the 275 Paadal Petra Sthalams. Fourteen Chola inscriptions survive here, and it is one of only three temples where Guru Bhagavan is said to have worshipped.
story: Sage Bharadwaja is said to have worshipped the deity in the form of a sparrow called valiyan, which gave the temple its name.
